verdict.rationale: Mistral is a model/API platform, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The only MCP evidence is a generic llms.txt definition of MCP as an open protocol for integrating models with tools. That describes client-side tool integration, not a first-party Mistral MCP server that an external agent can connect to, so no credit is given.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
